Please feel free to post your family stories like this one.

One hot summer day me and my cousin were playing in the kitchen. I believe we were about 8. My mom was out in the back yard mowing the grass. We were hungry so we opend up the cupboard and saw nothing but spices and sauces. So we started taking a teaspoon of each spice and putting it into a glass. Then we started adding sauces as well. Little bit of yellow mustard, now brown, here is some hot sauce and wine vinegar. Finally to top it off we added about 4 tablespoons of chocolate milk powder. The concoction filled half the glass we added water and stirred. My mom then walked in hot and sweaty from using that push mower to mow with. So we gave her the drink. She smiled at the cute little children and signed "Thank You". She was so hot and thirsty that she downed the whole glass like a shot of whiskey. At first she smiled and then she turned a greenish gray. I thought she was going to puke on us but she managed to make it to the sink as she was crying. She cranked the faucet on full blast and stuck the sprayer into her mouth. Me and my cousin rolled on the floor for about the next 30min as she drank. What happened next wasn't all that funny.
